gallery.title: File:160507-Z-OT568-009 (26907217356).jpg
gallery.artist: Oregon National Guard from Salem, Oregon, United States
gallery.description: Soldiers of 1st Squadron, 303rd Cavalry Regiment, Washington Army National Guard, stand in formation during the unit activation ceremony, May 7, 2016, at Camp Rilea Armed Forces Training Center, in Warrenton, Oregon. The 1-303rd Cavalry Squadron was part of the 81st Armored Brigade Combat Team and deactivated, February 21, 2016, as the 81st transforms into a Stryker Brigade Combat Team. It is now reactivated to fall under the 41st Infantry Brigade Combat Team (IBCT), Oregon Army National Guard when mobilized, with operational control under the Washington National Guard’s 96th Troop Command. (Photo by Sgt. 1st Class April Davis, Oregon Military Department Public Affairs)

gallery.title: File:130416-Z-XB575-003 (8665189299) (4).jpg
gallery.artist: oregonmildep from Salem, Oregon, United States
gallery.description: Maj. Gen. Raymond F. Rees, The Adjutant General, Oregon, and Lt. Gen. Tran Quang Khue, Deputy Chief of General Staff for the Vietnam People's Army, (both center), head up a delegation from Vietnam and the Oregon National Guard, for a visit to Camp Rilea, in Warrenton, Ore., April 16.  The Oregon National Guard hosted the delegation from Vietnam, April 14-19, and visited various facilities throughout Oregon.  The workshop itself included experts in several fields including academics, economics, port and maritime security, search and rescue, and humanitarian aid. The partnership between the Oregon National Guard and Vietnam was made official in November 2012, which pairs emerging democracies with National Guard states. Oregon currently has both Vietnam and Bangladesh as its state partners.  Photo by Spc. Marilyn Lowry, 115 Mobile Public Affairs Detachment.

gallery.title: File:140825-Z-OT568-320 (14881191947).jpg
gallery.artist: Oregon National Guard from Salem, Oregon, United States
gallery.description: Vice Admiral Pham Ngoc Minh (center), Deputy Chief of General Staff of Vietnam People’s Army and Vice Standing Chairman of Vietnam’s National Committee for Search and Rescue (VINASARCOM), and other visitors with the VINASARCOM delegation pose for a group photo with their hosts, Maj. Gen. Daniel Hokanson (on Minh’s left), Adjutant General, Oregon, and other members of the Oregon National Guard after visiting the Oregon National Guard’s CBRNE Enhanced Response Force Package (CERFP) annual certification training exercise, Aug. 25, at Camp Rilea in Warrenton, Ore. The Oregon National Guard is partnered with both Bangladesh and Vietnam’s VINASARCOM through its State Partnership Program. (Photo by Sgt. 1st Class April Davis, Oregon Military Department Public Affairs)

gallery.title: File:140825-Z-OT568-276 (15067758335).jpg
gallery.artist: Oregon National Guard from Salem, Oregon, United States
gallery.description: Oregon Army National Guard Capt. Thanh Vo (left, front), Search and Extraction Commander for Oregon’s CBRNE Enhanced Response Force Package (CERFP), briefs Vice Admiral Pham Ngoc Minh (far right), Deputy Chief of General Staff of Vietnam People’s Army and Vice Standing Chairman of Vietnam’s National Committee for Search and Rescue (VINASARCOM), and Maj. Gen. Daniel Hokanson (far left), Adjutant General, Oregon, during a tour of the unit’s annual certification training exercise, Aug. 25, at Camp Rilea in Warrenton, Ore. The VINASARCOM delegation visited Oregon National Guard facilities throughout the state to gain an understanding of Oregon’s emergency and disaster response preparedness in conjunction with the State Partnership Program. (Photo by Sgt. 1st Class April Davis, Oregon Military Department Public Affairs)

gallery.title: File:140827-Z-TK422-0926 (14872273477).jpg
gallery.artist: Oregon National Guard from Salem, Oregon, United States
gallery.description: Search and Extraction team members from the Oregon National Guard’s CBRNE Enhanced Response Force Package (CERFP) help escort a role-player medical patient during a week-long evaluation exercise held at Camp Rilea in Warrenton, Ore., Aug. 27. Approximately 200 Oregon Citizen-Soldiers and Airmen participated in the exercise, practicing incident site search and rescue, medical triage, and decontamination. Earlier this year, the unit worked alongside the Hawaii National Guard CERFP during the Vigilant Guard Exercise held in Anchorage, Alaska. (Photo by Master Sgt. Nick Choy, Oregon Military Department Public Affairs)

gallery.title: File:140825-Z-TK422-759 (15045053412).jpg
gallery.artist: Oregon National Guard from Salem, Oregon, United States
gallery.description: Oregon Army National Guard Maj. Charles Patzner, (left), Decontamination Element Commander, highlights the capabilities of his section for Mr. Hiroshi Furusawa, (center), Japanese Consul General, and Mr. Masahiro Tanaka, (third from left), Vice Consul, during a tour of Oregon’s CBRNE Enhanced Response Force Package (CERFP) evaluation exercise, held at Camp Rilea in Warrenton, Ore., Aug. 25. Furusawa and Tanaka, along with a number of other visitors from civilian, state and local agencies, toured the CERFP to get a first-hand look at how the unit trains for, and respond to, domestic emergency situations. (Photo by Master Sgt. Nick Choy, Oregon Military Department Public Affairs)
